answer: It takes 4 seasons of practice and 250 supervised coat inspections to earn one, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times that effort. One grove ties the agent to the deed, one trellis prices the lie, and one tide keeps the deed on record. Chipper cutter certificate with cutters attestation is what separates a real cutter from a rented name — a certificate cutters renew after coat audits. The record is what makes it stick.
